findings.evidence: Yosida.lean:306-312: conclusion is `‖lambda • LinearPMap.resolvent A lambda‖ ≤ M` from `hbound`, with no converse.
findings.fix: State it as an iff for `0 < lambda` (both directions are `field_simp`-level), or reword the docstring to describe the one implication actually proved.
findings.issue: The docstring of `norm_smul_resolvent_le` says the resolvent bound "is exactly the statement that the scaled resolvent has norm at most `M`", but only the forward implication is proved, so the advertised equivalence is not available to a caller who has `‖lambda • R‖ ≤ M`.

summary: The generalization of the convergence stage to a general resolvent constant is sound, but it deletes the m-dissipative entry points without replacement, so the same six-line hypothesis-discharge block is now pasted at three call sites; the PR also adds one lemma with no consumer and omits one it advertises.
